title: Rogers' book We Got It From Them

tellings.quote: >> Um to be really ingenious, I decided to call it We Got It From Them. [laughter]

plain: Greg Rogers, a doctor who says he worked with NASA and once saw a UFO inside a secret hangar, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2025 he wrote a book and, joking about how clever he was, named it We Got It From Them. He links it to Contact in the Desert, a UFO gathering where he spoke. The title states his point: that some human technology came from non-human craft.
